about: At age 65 the patient takes sertraline and has a new persistent standing blood pressure drop during treatment without dizziness.

possible finding: the record holds no line about "Persistent postural hypotension or dizziness while on the antidepressant". Lexapro (escitalopram) is supplied monthly for eleven months to a 74-year-old.
Dizziness predates mirtazapine and is unchanged, and the treatment review excludes both new dizziness and a new standing blood pressure drop.
